# Binmucker

> Binmucker is Conor Chepenik's personal internet home base: a searchable directory of useful tools, daily writing, Bitcoin projects, health experiments, recommendations, and playful web projects.

Canonical site: https://www.binmucker.com
Owner and author: Conor Chepenik
Business: Binmucker LLC

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.binmucker.com/): Search and filter every project, profile, experiment, recommendation, and support link. Also includes a browser-local Daily Desk for habits and private idea capture.
- [About Conor](https://www.binmucker.com/about): Conor's story, working principles, interests, and selected projects.
- [Writing](https://www.binmucker.com/blog): Essays published directly on Binmucker. Conor also links to his daily writing on Medium from the home page.
- [Free Local SEO Audit](https://www.binmucker.com/audit): A free tool that reviews a local business across search presence, reviews, content, technical SEO, and AI readiness.
- [Breathe Better](https://www.binmucker.com/breathe): A browser-based breathing practice with several guided patterns.
- [Breathing Practice](https://www.binmucker.com/breathe/practice): The interactive breathing timer.
- [Space Invaders](https://www.binmucker.com/space-invaders): A playable browser arcade game.
- [My Stack](https://www.binmucker.com/stack): Services and products Conor uses, with referral and affiliate disclosures.
- [Privacy](https://www.binmucker.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://www.binmucker.com/terms)

## Selected external projects

- [Bitcoin Coloring Book](https://bitcoincoloring.com/): A kid-friendly introduction to Bitcoin, sound money, and self-custody.
- [Sound Money Mortgage](https://soundmoneymortgage.com/): A mortgage calculator that includes Bitcoin opportunity cost.
- [Saylorscope](https://www.saylorscope.com/): A long-view investment comparison tool.
- [Fortune Sats](https://fortunesats.com/): A small Lightning experiment.
- [RyRacer](https://ryracer.com/): A 3D combat racing game with Lightning elements.
- [GuitarGui](https://guitargui.com/): An open-source collection of guitar tools.

## Referral disclosure

The home page and My Stack include clearly labeled referral or affiliate links for Venice AI, Gemini Credit Card, CrowdHealth, and Hostinger. Conor may receive credit or compensation if a visitor uses one of those links. Terms are controlled by the linked providers and may change.

## Site behavior

- The searchable directory is the most complete link inventory.
- Daily Desk habit and note data stay in the visitor's browser local storage.
- Weird Mode, the Konami code, cursor effects, and arcade references are optional easter eggs.
- No account is required for the home-page directory, Daily Desk, breathing tool, or arcade game.
